description:
Update platform registry to expose PySpark SQL capabilities
and auto-register the SQL adapter.

This enables the dual-mode platform pattern:
- `benchbox run --platform pyspark --mode sql` -> SQL adapter
- `benchbox run --platform pyspark --mode dataframe` -> DataFrame adapter (default)
- `benchbox run --platform pyspark` -> DataFrame adapter (default)

Registry changes:
- Update pyspark capabilities: supports_sql=True
- Add PySparkSQLAdapter to auto_register_platforms()
- Ensure mode selection logic works correctly
